scope: Dyad strict UTF-8 JSON acceptance only; application/schema validity unverified
recipe_visibility: evaluator-only; never add recipes, names, oracle outputs, rubric or payloads to provider context
rubric: Independent before/during/restored target and healthy-control oracle agree with frozen truth; cleanup succeeds.
Actual source-bound discriminating check and execution agree with task capture identity/hash/times and expected error; terminal scoped report uses this evidence.
Parser limits/unavailable remain uncertainty; valid capture is healthy control, not disproven historical failure.
Model evidence must be presented, considered and used in an applied deep response; ranked menu must include both competing file checks and retained custody.
Read-only source-bound probes, identical effective access and budgets, zero filename/content/request-hint leakage.
Preserve every attempt. Missing arms and failed/skipped cases stay in the frozen denominator. No model uplift is presumed.
qualification: Automated bounded-task correctness is distinct from authenticated model attribution and independent prose review. No overall model qualification from an unreviewed receipt.
